items.title: Sylvester Handy Interview, 1961-12-13
items.q: We work at Budweiser together. I played bass violin at Budweiser for years and years.

ctx.x: I think of his name before you leave. But right now, I can't. We work at Budweiser together. I played bass violin at Budweiser for years and years. And I can't think of his name. Booker. Booker.
